title: [BUG]
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ ] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ x] Other: Claude Code
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.70
- Operating System: macOS 15.5
- Terminal:  Ghostty

## Bug Description
When trying to run `/security-review` I'm getting this error:

```
> /security-review
  ⎿  Error: Bash command failed for pattern "!`git diff --merge-base origin/HEAD`": [stderr]
     usage: git diff [<options>] [<commit> [<commit>]] [--] [<path>...]

> why isn't security-review working?

⏺ The security-review command has a bug in its implementation. It's trying to use:
  git diff --merge-base origin/HEAD

  But --merge-base is not a valid option for git diff. The correct git commands would be:

  1. git diff origin/HEAD...HEAD (three dots for changes on current branch)
  2. git diff $(git merge-base origin/HEAD HEAD)..HEAD (using merge-base separately)

  This is a bug in the Claude Code security-review command itself. You should report this issue at https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues

  As a workaround, I can manually review your changes for security concerns:
```

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Open Claude Code in CLI
2. type `/security-review`

## Expected Behavior
It should run a security review

## Actual Behavior
Getting this error:
```
Error: Bash command failed for pattern "!`git diff --merge-base origin/HEAD`": [stderr]
     usage: git diff [<options>] [<commit> [<commit>]] [--] [<path>...]
```
